lines.text: Rome wasn't built in a day. It took centuries.
Your money works the same way. It's called compound interest.
Your money makes money. Then that money makes money.
lines.say: Your money makes money. Then THAT money makes money.

lines.text: A hundred a month for forty years? You put in forty-eight thousand.
At eight percent a year, it grows past three hundred thousand.
And you want to get rich by Friday?
